summary.text: Matt Moonen (listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Moonen) is a Democratic state representative from Portland, Maine, who represents District 117 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2012 to 2020, including as majority leader from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Moonen lives in Portland, Maine, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northwestern University in 2006.
Moonen represented Maine House District 38 from 2012 to 2020, and Ballotpedia reports that he served as state House majority leader from 2018 to 2020.
He took office again on December 6, 2022, representing District 117, succeeding Frances Head.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Judiciary Committee for 2023-2024 and as a member of the Rules and Business of the House Committee for 2025-2026.
